title: coordinator-detail.md's DEPENDS_ON bash snippet parses roadmap get-phase JSON so the declared-dependency integration-tester spawn (step 3b) can actually fire at runtime

context.gap_description: Snippet calls 'roadmap get-phase {N} --raw' but --raw on this subcommand prints raw markdown section text (by design), not JSON; JSON.parse always throws and the catch branch yields '[]' unconditionally, so DEPENDS_ON is always empty regardless of ROADMAP.md content. Pre-existing since Phase 54 (a87c17c) but load-bearing for MILE-38's new step 3b built directly on it. Found by gsd-integration-tester (blocking contract_mismatch). Fix: drop --raw from the DEPENDS_ON snippet (both step 3 shared block and step 3b) + regression test executing the literal bash line.
